oligopoly.name: Oligopoly (Bertrand-Nash with Differentiation)
oligopoly.description: High mutual interdependence, significant cross-price elasticity. Price cuts trigger aggressive retaliation.

monopolistic.name: Monopolistic Competition (High SKU / Brand Differentiation)
monopolistic.description: Firms possess captive niches (e.g., Zepto Cafe, BB Fresh Organic). Cross-price elasticity is lower; price cuts steal fewer rivals' customers.

aiStrategies.name: Price Matcher
aiStrategies.description: Sets price to match the lowest price set by any competitor in the previous round.

aiStrategies.name: Predatory Undercutter
aiStrategies.description: Sets price 5% to 8% lower than the lowest competitor price, bounded by unit cost floor.

aiStrategies.name: Margin Defender (Hold)
aiStrategies.description: Maintains a constant disciplined price aimed at protecting unit profit margins, ignoring competitor cuts.

aiStrategies.name: Tit-For-Tat Retaliator
aiStrategies.description: Cooperates at baseline if rivals hold, but punishes aggressively if the user or any rival initiates an undercut.
